svg.font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: HireTracker resume parser
svg.desc: Animated walkthrough: five resumes in different formats are uploaded, read automatically, checked in one table, and created as candidates in one click.

g.text: Upload many at once. We read each one and fill in the candidate for you.
PDF, Word or phone photos. Up to 100 at a time.
Reading 5 resumes. Scanned PDFs and photos are handled too.
5 resumes read · 1 needs a quick check
Aman, Rohit, Priya, Sneha and Dev are in Screening
